modules.title: Blind-zone awareness
modules.summary: Know the excavator's blind zones, use cameras and mirrors, and set up exclusion zones with ground crew.

modules.title: Efficient machine operation
modules.summary: Reduce unproductive idle, use auto-idle and engine shutdown, and coordinate truck spotting to keep cycles flowing.

modules.title: Pre-operation safety
modules.summary: Seatbelt, mount/dismount, walk-around and pre-start checks before any machine movement.

modules.title: Working on wet ground
modules.summary: Travel speed, slope stability, bench edge distance and track slip on wet or soft ground.
